skills.name: ae-clean-rig
skills.description: Entry point for every After Effects task through this MCP. Load first whenever the user wants to build, edit, animate, fix, inspect, verify, render or save an After Effects project, comp, layer, text, shape, effect, expression or keyframe. Routes to references and companion skills.
